name: Wall Push-Up
steps: Face the wall and set both palms against it, chest high and just outside the line of your shoulders.
Step back until your body slopes toward the wall and brace to keep your head, hips and heels aligned.
Bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your ribs to lean your chest slowly toward the wall.
Press smoothly through both palms to straighten your arms back to the starting position.
tips: Keep your body straight like a moving plank rather than hinging at the hips or sagging your lower back.
Step slightly farther away from the wall as you grow stronger to increase resistance.
